name: separator
useFor: Use Separator between groups in a list, a menu or a toolbar, and the dashed variant for a guide inside a band or between plans. Rules are decorative unless decorative={false}.
constraints: Rules around every row where a list already rules them
source: The Hoplite website's quiet rules (--line-quiet under the header and between FAQ rows) and dashed guides (--rule-dash-y, .pr-plan__mark)
title: Separator
description: The site's rules: a quiet 16 percent 1px line, or the section guide's dashes (10px on an 18px period), across or down.
